title: ID0392187-DC/SID/BE-[MP / R4 170001624]-Wrong ccv delivery from factory
description:
Reported behavior/ issue:  Wrong delivered ccv terminals inside chargers from factory. Inside the charger we have a wrong ccv terminal. Needs to be ccv opm c60 and here we have in two chargers OPx-C60 cardprocess sw56, see attached picture. The second picture is what it should be.
Root cause:
Solution
170001624/170001621
